messages.subject: Replicates in R Package 'Distance'
parts:
I've looked around for information and examples however I cannot seem to find how R deals with replicates in 'Distance'. Would you identify replicates under Region.Label, or simply under 'Effort' (so first time sampling transect 1 would be '1a' and then second sample would be '1b' and so on) - or is there something entirely different?
 
Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Replicates in R Package 'Distance'
parts:
Tim

You would account for re-visiting transects via the "Effort" mechanism (if a line transect, total effort is line length multiplied by number of transits of the transect), and sightings across all transits are recorded for that transect.

Using the Region.Label is not the correct approach because each unique label will be considered a unique transect, resulting in an inflation in the number of replicate transects.

I've looked around for information and examples however I cannot seem to find how R deals with replicates in 'Distance'. Would you identify replicates under Region.Label, or simply under 'Effort' (so first time sampling transect 1 would be '1a' and then second sample would be '1b' and so on) - or is there something entirely different?
 
Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks
